summary: This video demonstrates a fast 24-second speed clear of Grave of Venom Challenge 6 using an Aura archetype team. The lineup includes Anneliesis, Talethia, Lincos, Diantha, and Eurion. Full gear and stat builds are shown for each hero at the end of the run.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Delivers heavy damage in fast Grave of Venom Challenge 6 speed runs.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Provides additional damage burst to clear Deadly Harpy rapidly.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.note: Enables high damage potential and utility for the Aura composition.

heroes.name: Diantha
heroes.note: Key damage dealer for quick dungeon boss clears.

heroes.name: Eurion
heroes.note: Keeps the squishy Aura team alive while they burst down the boss.

teams.note: Achieves a 24-second clear on Grave of Venom Challenge 6.

tips: Combine high-burst Aura DPS heroes with Eurion to safely speed run Grave of Venom Challenge 6.
title: Aura Team vs Grave of Venom — Deadly Harpy CHALLENGE 6! | Dragonheir: Silent Gods
